episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When a series of terrible murders ensues in a residential area, Cha Su-yeol is forced to seek help from Jung I-shin, a serial killer from the past.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The culprit has been arrested, but the victim's whereabouts remain unknown. Su-yeol struggles to save a life as I-shin reveals her true intentions.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: I-shin offers assistance with the investigation, but it's unclear why she would help a cop. Su-yeol unravels the origins of I-shin's murderous instinct.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The culprit begins to close in on Su-yeol's family. I-shin pressures Su-yeol to take action — but she happens to be the one threatening his family.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Su-yeol finds I-shin in his home after she vanishes under police watch. The killer demands to speak to I-shin and gives her a hint about the plan.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Shaken by recent events, Su-yeol attempts to confide in Lee Jung-yeon. During a tense call, I-shin manipulates the killer into exposing a crucial lead.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: As Jung-yeon copes with the truth of Su-yeol's past, the killer reveals their identity — and takes a hostage, forcing Su-yeol into a dangerous bargain.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: After a tense hostage exchange, I-shin confronts her protégé. Su-yeol makes a grim discovery about his family's fractured past.
